name: Schema and Data Contract Validator
description: Validate explicit payloads and compare bounded JSON Schema draft-07 or Protobuf contracts using pinned libraries. Unsupported constructs are refused.
author: Sara team

es.Validate explicit payloads and compare b: Valida cargas y compara contratos JSON Schema draft-07 o Protobuf acotados con bibliotecas fijadas. Rechaza construcciones no admitidas.

fr.Validate explicit payloads and compare b: Valide les données et compare des contrats JSON Schema draft-07 ou Protobuf bornés avec des bibliothèques figées. Refuse les constructions non prises en charge.

de.Validate explicit payloads and compare b: Validiert Daten und vergleicht begrenzte JSON-Schema-draft-07- oder Protobuf-Verträge mit festen Bibliotheken. Nicht unterstützte Konstrukte werden abgelehnt.

pt-BR.Validate explicit payloads and compare b: Valida dados e compara contratos JSON Schema draft-07 ou Protobuf limitados com bibliotecas fixadas. Recusa construções não suportadas.

it.Validate explicit payloads and compare b: Valida dati e confronta contratti JSON Schema draft-07 o Protobuf limitati con librerie fissate. Rifiuta costrutti non supportati.
